text:
Maria G.: Quick idea — run a short 3-email 'Early Access Wireframe' mini-drip for folks who signed up for the private preview. Goal: increase activation and book 1:1 demos. Target window: 7 days post-signup.

Jamal R.: love it. do we split by product interest? (infra vs sdk vs api)

Maria G.: yes — 3 segments: infra, sdk, api. plus a general bucket for undecided. content will be lightly tailored (1 sentence). keep the rest consistent for measurement.

Sarah L.: subject line variants ready. A/B test two each send:
- V1: "You're in — early access to Redwood inference"
- V2: "Peek the new inference runtime — early access"
- V3: "Claim your Early Access slot"
- V4: "See how fast inference can be"

Alex P.: send cadence proposal:
```
T+0: invite + quick how-to (day 0)
T+3: short case study + demo CTA (day 3)
T+7: last-chance + scheduler link (day 7)
send windows: 9am local / 2pm local fallback for APAC
```

Maria G.: love the cadence. can growth-bot attach utm params? want: utm_source=ea, utm_medium=email, utm_campaign=wireframe_1761

Leo (growth-bot): will append utm params automatically when you flag the campaign as `ea-wireframe-1761`. Also adding `utm_content` with segment name.

Jamal R.: routing question — webinar signups and product demo leads should dedupe into the same audience. can we stop the drip if they click the scheduler?

Alex P.: yes — webhook from scheduler hits our inbox and flags contact property `scheduled_demo=true`. rule: if scheduled_demo=true -> suppress remaining drip. I'll add to deliverability flow.

Sarah L.: small ask on creative: tweak hero image copy per segment: infra -> "Predictable latency at scale", sdk -> "Ship features faster", api -> "Plug into our hosted API". keeps A/B fair.

Maria G.: agreed. Jamal, can you publish the segment lists to the campaign channel by EOD? need sample sizes for power calc.

Jamal R.: will do. rough estimates now: infra=420, sdk=310, api=270, general=1350. sending to #campaign-ops in 30.

Leo (growth-bot): noted. if any recipients are on the do-not-email list we will exclude automatically.

Alex P.: small tracking snippet for ops (add to campaign config):
```json
{"campaign":"ea-wireframe-1761","suppress_on":"scheduled_demo","utm":"utm_source=ea&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wireframe_1761"}
```

Sarah L.: subject A/B sample split suggestion: 30/70 for the bigger segments, 50/50 for smaller ones to preserve lift sensitivity.

Maria G.: keep 30/70 across board — we want a clear winner quickly.

Jamal R.: one more — can we surface a short survey link in email 2 for SDK folks (1 question: main blocker)? adds a tiny friction but yields quality qual signals.

Sarah L.: ok but make it optional and tiny. we'll add it as a 1-click micro-survey (Google Form link).

Alex P.: scheduling detail — rolling send over 48 hours to smooth throttle. SES quotas are fine but want to avoid spikes.

Maria G.: perfect. final checklist: segments published, creatives per segment, utm flagged, webhook suppression, send window + throttle config. target launch: next Tue 9am PT.

Jamal R.: publishing segments now — ping when creative is uploaded.

Sarah L.: creative upload ETA 5pm PT today. I'll drop links and alt-text in the thread.

Leo (growth-bot): campaign draft saved: ea-wireframe-1761 (draft). I will run a preflight check 1 hour before launch and post results here. :robot_face:

Maria G.: thanks all — this is lean and measurable. will follow up with the campaign doc and calendar invite. :thumbsup:
